1.title: CLI crashes when the config file is empty
1.body: Running `tool build` with an empty `tool.json` throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'targets')`. An empty config should fall back to the defaults.

2.title: Retry failed HTTP requests with exponential backoff
2.body: `fetchJson` gives up on the first 5xx. Retry up to 3 times with exponential backoff (200ms, 400ms, 800ms) before throwing.

3.title: Stream the log parser instead of reading whole files
3.body: `parseLog` reads the entire file into memory and runs out of memory on multi-GB logs. Parse line by line from a stream.

5.title: Reject negative quantities when adding to the cart
5.body: `addToCart(cart, sku, qty)` accepts `qty = -3`, and the cart total goes negative. Throw a `RangeError` for any quantity below 1.

prs.title: Fall back to defaults when the config file is empty
prs.body:
Fixes #1

An empty file parses to null, so merge it with the defaults instead.
